description_en: Migrates a Data Warehouse Edition cluster to a Data Lakehouse Edition or an Enterprise Edition cluster
description_zh: 调用MigrateDBCluster将数仓版迁移至湖仓版或企业版集群
name: MigrateDBCluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The reserved computing resources. Valid values: 0 ACU to 4096 ACU. The step size is 16. One AnalyticDB Compute Unit (ACU) is approximately equivalent to 1 core and 4 GB of memory.

Include the unit when you specify this parameter. This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to LegacyForm
parameters.help_zh:
计算预留资源。取值范围：0ACU～4096ACU，步长：16。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。
参数填写时，需要带单位，仅ProductForm取值为LegacyForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
The reserved storage resources. Valid values: 0 ACU to 2064 ACU. The step size is 3 × the number of ACUs specified by the StorageResourceSize parameter. The default value is 24 ACU. One ACU is approximately equivalent to 1 core and 4 GB of memory.

Include the unit when you specify this parameter. This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to LegacyForm
parameters.help_zh:
存储预留资源。取值范围：0ACU～2064ACU，步长等于StorageResourceSize参数指定ACU数 * 3 （默认24ACU）。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。
参数填写时，需要带单位，仅ProductForm取值为LegacyForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: storage_resource

parameters.help_en:
The node specifications for the reserved storage resources. Valid values: 8ACU, 12ACU, and 16ACU.

Include the unit when you specify this parameter. This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to LegacyForm
parameters.help_zh:
存储预留资源节点规格，支持8ACU，12ACU，16ACU
参数填写时，需要带单位，仅ProductForm取值为LegacyForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: storage_resource_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of shards. Specify this parameter to change the number of shards for the instance during the migration.

This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to LegacyForm
parameters.help_zh:
分片数。指定迁移同时修改实例分片（Shard）数目。
仅ProductForm取值为LegacyForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: shard_number

parameters.help_en:
The node specifications for the reserved storage resources. Valid values: 8ACU, 12ACU, and 16ACU.

Include the unit when you specify this parameter. This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
存储预留资源节点规格，支持8ACU，12ACU，16ACU
参数填写时，需要带单位，仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: reserved_node_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of reserved nodes.

For the Enterprise Edition, the default value is 3 and the step size is 3.

For the Basic Edition, the default value is 1.

This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
预留节点数。 
企业版默认为3节点，步长为3。
基础版默认为1节点。
仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: reserved_node_count

parameters.help_en:
The product edition. Valid values:

BasicVersion: Basic Edition.

EnterpriseVersion: Enterprise Edition.

This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本。取值为：
BasicVersion：基础版。
EnterpriseVersion：企业版。
仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: product_version

parameters.help_en:
The product form. Valid values:

IntegrationForm: Integrated form.

LegacyForm: Data Lakehouse Edition
parameters.help_zh:
产品形态。取值为：
IntegrationForm：融合形态。
LegacyForm：湖仓版
parameters.name: product_form

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the secondary zone.

This parameter cannot have the same value as the ZoneId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区ID。
本参数和ZoneId属性不能相同
parameters.name: secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the secondary virtual switch.

This parameter cannot have the same value as the VSwitchId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
备虚拟交换机ID。
本参数和VSwitchId属性不能相同
parameters.name: secondary_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request to verify that the migration requirements are met. The migration is not performed.

false (Default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求, 默认为 false。取值范围：
true：发送检查请求，检查是否满足迁移要求，并不会执行实际执行迁移操作。
false（默认）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run
